title: Logistic regression as a named Bernoulli GLM
dek: Wikipedia logistic page is the celebrity GLM. Odds ratios and separation live on stats-logit.
story: Logistic regression on Wikipedia is the celebrity: Bernoulli (or binomial) with logit link, coefficients as log odds ratios. It is a GLM, not a separate kingdom.
stats-logit already walks odds versus risk, complete separation, and Firth. This card is the encyclopedia celebrity that students search before they will search 'Bernoulli GLM'.
Do not read exp(β) as a risk ratio. That error has its own stats plate energy and an odds-ratio glossary sibling.
deep: Probit and cloglog are sibling Bernoulli GLMs with different links.
Case-control sampling changes intercept interpretation more than slopes under a logit — a design note, not Wikipedia methods paste.
GWAS per-SNP logistics are still this celebrity, plus structure covariates (stats-gwas).
Calibration of predicted π is a different object (posterior-calibration / reliability).

visual.caption: Logit maps a real linear predictor onto (0,1). The three curves are schematic: a latent-ish linear predictor, the implied Bernoulli mean, and a misread linear-probability mean that can leave [0,1].
